summary: LRE implemented in 15 Java files (controller, 5 operations, sensor, register, actuator, events, constants). All 51 requirements are traced. 10 issues flagged: 2 invented defaults, 3 ambiguities, 4 design choices, 1 scope question.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are natural numbers but 'none' is specified as -1
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/Var6 declare cstc and cdyn as natural numbers with -1 meaning no obstacle; LRE-DM5/OP3/OP4 have closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1. A nat cannot be -1.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented 'none' as the index 2147483647 (Sensor.NO_OBSTACLE_INDEX), which ObstacleRegister never stores (MAX_INDEX = 2147483646). Every distance function returns the safe large distance for it and every field accessor returns 0, so no guard needs to test for 'none'. Confirm or supply the intended encoding.

issues.title: Safe large distance for a missing obstacle = 1000000.0 m
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires odist/hdist/vdist to return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists, without giving a value.
issues.fix_directive: Used 1000000.0 m (Sensor.NO_OBSTACLE_DIST). Any value well above every threshold (all 1 m) works.

issues.title: CPA geometry: sign conventions, horizontal approach, constant vertical separation
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 does not give the CPA formula. ns_rel_dist/ew_rel_dist are taken as obstacle position minus AUV position; obs_ns_vel/obs_ew_vel as absolute velocities (LRE-DM2 calls an obstacle with zero velocity static).
issues.fix_directive: tcpa = (p.w)/(|w|^2 + CPA_EPSILON), where p is the relative position and w = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity (horizontal). cda = sqrt(|p - w*tcpa|^2 + vdist^2): the vertical separation is taken as constant, so obs_roc and rate_of_climb are not used. With no dynamic obstacle, p = 0 and vdist is large, so cda is large and CAM is not entered. This also reconciles OP5's 'large-distance defaults' with DM5's zero-valued accessors.

issues.title: CPA_EPSILON = 0.000001 keeps the tcpa denominator non-zero
issues.raw: tcpa divides by the squared relative speed, which is zero when the AUV and the obstacle move together. The compute() profile allows no if-else.
issues.fix_directive: Added CPA_EPSILON = 0.000001 to the denominator. The model's constants interface rounds it up to 1. The denominator stays positive, so the sign of tcpa (the only thing the guards test) is unchanged; the model's cda value is only approximate.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: The system description says HCM runs at reduced speed (0.1 m/s); LRE-FR3 says entering HCM advises 0 m/s.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1 says 'vvel is the rate of climb'; LRE-Beh11 tests vvel >= 1 m/s, so a fast descent does not trigger Beh11.
issues.fix_directive: Kept the literal reading (vvel = rate_of_climb, signed). A descent is still covered by Beh10, which does not depend on velocity.

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements share priority 8; the requirements give no relative order.
issues.fix_directive: MOM: reqOCM, endTask, inOpez, collision course, Beh9, Beh11, Beh10, reqHCM. HCM: reqOCM, inOpez, collision course, clear (Beh13). CAM: reqOCM, cda safe. OCM: reqVel, reqHdng, reqMOM. Every branch below a guard-only branch conjoins the negation of the guards above it. Beh11 is placed before Beh10: with equal thresholds (1 m), Beh10 placed first would make Beh11's guard unsatisfiable.

issues.title: State variables are held by the operations
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..Var8 say 'the controller maintains' each variable; the profile lets an operation own the variables it computes.
issues.fix_directive: Each variable is a field of the operation that computes it, exposed through a getter of the same name. The controller's guards read the getters. CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA read the closest index from the sensor again (fields staticIndex/dynIndex), because compute() may use only sensor calls and its own fields. The value is the same as cstc/cdyn within a step.

issues.title: Literal thresholds of Beh4/Beh9/Beh11 named as constants
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 (vel <= 1, odist > 1) and LRE-Beh9/Beh11 (>= 1 m/s) give literal values that are not among the four DM4 constants.
issues.fix_directive: Added MOM_ENTRY_MAX_VEL, MOM_ENTRY_MIN_DIST and CAUTION_VEL (each 1.0), and MOM_ADVISED_VEL / STOP_VEL for the advised velocities. Beh4's distance bound was not identified with minSafeDist.

issues.title: CAM evasive manoeuvre is not specified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres in CAM, but no requirement gives the advice to issue (only advVel/advHdng exist).
issues.fix_directive: Entering CAM issues no advice; the controller only leaves CAM through Beh17/Beh18. Supply the manoeuvre if one is intended.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit these choices only if the verifiers or the operator object.
